title: Poincare inequality on the unit ball for W^{1,2}(B)
statement: For every n >= 1 there is a constant C >= 0 (C = 2^{n+2} works) such that the following holds. For all f : R^n -> R and g : R^n -> R^n with IsW12WithGradient f g B (B the open unit ball), int_B |f(x) - lambda|^2 dx <= C int_B |g|^2, where lambda is the average of f over B, i.e. |B|^{-1} int_B f. Both sides are lintegrals of squared extended norms, and the right side is ENNReal.ofReal C times the energy.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient f g (ball 0 1) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f x - ⨍ y in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C * ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖g x‖ₑ ^ 2
